newsitem.title: USA: Workforce calls off Star Hosiery purchase.
newsitem.headline: Workforce calls off Star Hosiery purchase.

text.p: Workforce Systems Corp said Wednesday it will end its efforts to acquire most of Star Hosiery Inc, despite Bankruptcy Court approval of its proposal to assume or pay certain of Star's liabilities.

The company said the terms it has been presented with for equity financing neeeded to facilitate the transaction and operate Star's business are unacceptable and would prove "highly unfair" to current shareholders.

Specifically, Workforce said that any financing transactions involving the use of Regulation S offerings, or consisting of convertible preferred shares that do not have a price floor in the conversion feature or similar protective measures, to be wholly unacceptable, because it would cause a significant dilution of current shareholder interest.
